6.0 Recommendation bullet list. Add report-specific items below the standard one. Same variable name as the Web and MAPT templates.
userDefinedFields.defaultValue:
• Cover all the findings stated in this report.
  • Unless a resource is intended to be publicly accessible, deny access by default.
  • Update the outdated services, versions and libraries.
  • Remove default credentials and harden every exposed service configuration.
  • Continue regular security assessments – Conduct periodic penetration tests (at least annually or after major changes) to ensure the security posture remains robust against evolving threats.
  • Maintain patch and update cycles – Keep all software, frameworks, and infrastructure components updated to mitigate any future vulnerabilities.
  • Implement continuous monitoring and logging – Ensure that active security monitoring solutions (e.g., SIEM, IDS/IPS) are in place to quickly detect and respond to suspicious activities.
